name: Canadian University Dubai
englishBachelors: Business, engineering, architecture, communication, environmental health and applied sciences, on a Canadian curriculum model.
note: Built on a Canadian curriculum with credit-transfer arrangements to Canadian universities, in a landmark tower on Sheikh Zayed Road. A route into a Canadian education without Canadian tuition.
summary: Canadian-curriculum university on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, with bachelor's degrees in architecture, engineering and computing, business, communication and health.
about: CUD offers Canadian-style degrees accredited by the UAE Ministry of Higher Education. It accepts applications for Fall, Spring and Summer, and sets IB entry as a 24-point Diploma plus subject minimums for engineering.

ib.text: IB Diploma with six subjects and 24+ points; Engineering needs 5 in Maths, Physics and Biology or Chemistry. IB certificate holders are assessed on their credentials. English proof may be waived.

notes: IB entry: Diploma holders need 24 points and six subjects (Islamic Education excluded) to meet the UAE equivalency rule. Students with the certificate rather than the Diploma can apply and are assessed on their credentials. A UAE Ministry of Education equivalency certificate is required.

Engineering entry (IB): at least 5 in Mathematics, Physics and one of Biology or Chemistry; the page does not say whether HL or SL. Other degrees list no IB subject grade on this page. Applicants need attested transcripts for grades 10-12 and passport, Emirates ID and photo.

English: exempt if English was the medium of instruction at a non-UAE English-curriculum school (official proof needed). Otherwise IELTS Academic 5.0, TOEFL iBT 61 (2.5 on the new scale) or TOEFL ITP 500; the BA in Creative Industries needs IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 71. Below this you start in the English for Academic Purposes programme.

Maths placement test is required unless you hold an SAT Maths of 450+ or a UAE certificate with Maths 70%+; communication, psychology and creative-industries degrees are exempt. Students who fail may be admitted conditionally and take a remedial Maths course first.

Dates: CUD admits for Fall, Spring and Summer 1 and says applications are accepted all year. Fall 2027 dates are not published. For Fall 2026 applications opened on 1 March 2026 and international applicants had to apply by 21 August 2026; file completion was 28 August.

Teaching language: the reviewed pages do not state a language-of-instruction rule; English proof is required and programme pages are in English. Confirm with admissions before relying on it for a given programme.

Tuition (AED, VAT inclusive, from the fee page tab labelled 2025-26; no 2027-28 table is published): Computer Science AED 72,466 for 30 credits a year; Architecture AED 88,476 for 35 credits; BBA in Management AED 2,359.35 per credit hour (30 credits a year). Plus about AED 2,236.50 a year in incidental fees. Same table for all applicants.
Check scholarships and special discounts on the fees page; none were verified here for IB applicants.

languageOfInstruction.note: English proof is required unless English was the school's teaching language; no explicit language-of-instruction rule was found on the pages reviewed.

admissionRoutes.text: A Diploma with six subjects and at least 24 points meets the UAE equivalency rule; engineering also needs 5 in Maths, Physics and Biology or Chemistry.
Applicants with the IB certificate rather than the Diploma can apply and are assessed on the high school credentials they provide.
